method: Interactive published-site UI checks using the approved CUA browser API; DOM/AX state, native UI actions, and actual completed download. No shell browser automation.

checks.name: Published version and sender deep link
checks.observed: Allmiibo Dateimanager 3.65.0; LCD DE3.102 / App675; stream workspace open; LCD 128 x 64 preview visibly renders the animated circle and wave.

checks.name: Rotation, conversion, fit and rate controls
checks.observed: 90 degrees, Photo dot pattern, Crop to fill and 10 frames/s selectable; selected values confirmed in UI.

checks.name: Options persist across workspace switch and page reload
checks.observed: After Files -> Image & video -> Reload, the same four selected option values remained visible.

checks.name: Reset restores defaults
checks.observed: Fit whole image, 0 degrees, Clear shapes, threshold 128 and 5 frames/s restored.

checks.name: Player export preparation and completion
checks.observed: Default duration 10 seconds: 50 frames, 51,216 B, 5 frames/s. Create player file completed and exposed a separate Save file link. Nothing was automatically written to a device.

checks.name: Actual player-file download
checks.observed: Clicking Save file completed a browser download. Binary header and exact file length checked below.

checks.name: German and English sender labels
checks.observed: Language menu switches all observed sender controls, export summary and save instructions to English; restored German before completion.

checks.name: App675 package selection and browser hash check
checks.observed: LCD selection offers App675 and retains earlier packages. Opening the selected package in DFU then Load and check package completed with Package SHA-256 verified, application counter 675, hardware field 52 and accepted SoftDevice FWID 0x0126. No DFU device selected.

checks.name: Catalogue game filter and new figure details
checks.observed: 956 entries. Kirby Star Allies plus search Sword returns Kirby mit Schwert & Dragoon, ID 1f00010004c51e03. Details contain the corresponding Star Allies usage and Nintendo source, along with the other supported Switch/ Switch 2 titles; Miitopia explicitly excludes 3DS for this figure.

limits: The cloud browser reports no Web Bluetooth support; sending and DFU transfer were not performed.
No physical LCD/OLED, NFC, Switch/Switch 2, radio throughput, energy or hardware frame-rate test.
These are nine scoped interactive checks, not a complete browser regression suite.
Local media upload, codec coverage, drag/drop and physical playback retain their separately documented automated or device-test scope.
